auto_reconnect_delay.description: Seconds to wait before attempting to reconnect automatically.

auto_rejoin_delay.description: Seconds to wait before automatically rejoining a channel after a disconnect.

beep_max.description: Maximum number of beeps to emit at once.

beep_when_away.description: Controls beep behavior when away (0 = off, non-zero = on).

channel_name_width.description: Maximum width for channel names in the status bar.

connect_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for connecting to a server.

cpu_saver_after.description: Number of seconds of inactivity before CPU saver is enabled.

cpu_saver_every.description: Frequency in seconds for CPU saver checks.

dcc_sliding_window.description: Number of DCC connections to maintain in sliding window.

dcc_store_path.description: Directory to store incoming DCC files.

dcc_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for DCC transfers.

display_pc_characters.description: Number of PC character columns to display (for 8-bit chars).

high_bit_escape.description: Escape method for high-bit characters (0 = none).

history.description: Maximum number of lines stored in command history.

lastlog.description: Number of lines kept in lastlog buffer.

nd_space_max.description: Maximum number of spaces for ND (non-digit) formatting.

num_of_whowas.description: Number of recent users to keep in WHOWAS cache.

scrollback.description: Number of scrollback lines to keep.

scroll_lines.description: Number of lines to scroll per scroll event.

shell_flags.description: Flags passed to the shell for command execution.
